flop_exclusions: FP32 scale promotion, softmax, norms, quantization, padding and draft omitted from the tensor-only bound; their cost is not zero.
Router is BF16 and is kept separate.
steady_prefill_log_window: server-local 17:05:00 <= timestamp <17:06:20 (80 seconds within official measurement)

fc2_payload.interpretation: Counts predict logical outgoing payload. Whole-iteration average does not measure burst bandwidth, transfer latency, or non-overlap; do not add the communication bound to the compute bound.

caveats: All experts assumed touched; logical unique weight/KV bytes are not DRAM-counter measurements.
No draft time, scale/activation traffic, repeated reads, graph padding or synchronization in this memory-only bound.
Meeting average step budget alone does not establish per-request ITL SLA.

ep8_plus_ep4_prefill.classification: Required gain, not a speed prediction. Current 2WG, SF128, dynamic scheduling and replication guards specialize rank4; porting only the launch flags would not test the current optimized kernel. Prior EP8 failures used Triton/DeepEP and do not establish current MegaMoE EP8 performance.

pp12_ep1_prefill.gpu_partition: P:12 pipeline stages,1 GPU/expert group each; D:4 unchanged
pp12_ep1_prefill.eagle_aux_forwarding_assumption: Capture outputs near layers2/47/91 and carry early/middle auxiliary states to the last stage:17 total extra boundary traversals for this partition. Confirm actual indexing before implementation.
pp12_ep1_prefill.classification: Structural candidate, not implemented or measured. Complete token/model operations retained. Need stage-balanced microbatches, correct EAGLE auxiliary states/draft extend, PP KV lifetime and NIXL transfer, and local MegaMoE specialization. Additional fill/drain/SLA loss can change the required stage period.
pp12_ep1_prefill.closed_loop_budget_assessment: At current nominal ITL and c215, only about951.5ms is available for meanTTFT. A901-921ms ideal pipeline traversal leaves little time for queueing, draft extend and transfer; do not prioritize this layout from payload reduction alone.

pp4_ep1_three_prefill_replicas.gpu_partition: P:3 independent4-stage pipelines, EP1; D:4 unchanged. Place each pipeline inside one8-GPU NVLink node.
pp4_ep1_three_prefill_replicas.aux_assumption: Capture immediately before layers2/47/91, matching pinned Qwen default. With stages[24,24,23,23], earlystate crosses3 boundaries, middlestate2, lateststate0. Correct capture on non-last stages and auxiliary forwarding must be implemented; current Qwen enables capture only on the last PP rank.
pp4_ep1_three_prefill_replicas.classification: Quantitatively less constrained than PP12/mb4 by latency, not implemented or a speed prediction. Remote FC2 bytes become local writes; local BF16 partial/combine work is not eliminated. Smaller microbatch increases weight reads and padding; measured grouping may change routing/rounding. Stage balancing, EAGLE auxiliary/draft handling, NIXL/KV lifetime and localMegaMoE specialization remain required.

moe_tile_padding_screen.provenance: Existing held-out logical routing counts from40621030371;48 prompts,4001tokens each. EP1 groups contiguous source-rank requests in groups of1,2,4; a hypothetical grouping, not a measured PP workload. N/K tile factors assumed unchanged. No GPU run.

tensor_floor_with_observed_moe_padding.exclusions: Still excludes attention/dense tile rounding, non-tensor instructions, scale/activation movement, draft and synchronization. This is not an attainable latency forecast.

closed_loop_concurrency_budget.formula: Little law: C >= request_rate * mean_end_to_end_latency; nominal decode=199*mean_ITL. Assumes all215 request slots active, same delivery fraction, fixed200-token output; finite-window and variable output effects are not inferred away.

expert_weight_model.description: Unique FP8 expert weights read once per microbatch, amortized per request. Logical cold-weight model, NOT measured HBM bytes or all issued TMA/L2 loads. Cache reuse, per-M-tile repeated accesses, scale loads and activation/output traffic are excluded.
expert_weight_model.interpretation: Both unique-weight-only arithmetic intensities exceed the nominal ridge. That does not establish whole-kernel compute limitation: L2/shared delivery, instruction issue and synchronization may stall tensor work. Neither a1.83x kernel slowdown nor unchanged runtime follows. Do not sum compute and HBM time floors.

nsys.relation_to_current: Historical same target-kernel selection baseline, BF16 draft; NOT the9235/9234 normal serving run.
nsys.scope: Same-run same-capture timestamp membership. The counter sampling interval may extend outside the kernel; all selected windows require every CUDA device to be executing MegaMoE at the sample timestamp.
limitations: No raw DRAM byte counts, L2 traffic or per-PC stalls.
No FC1/FC2 phase resolution; sample interval may overlap other kernels.
Low average bandwidth is not proof of absent memory latency or short burst saturation.

ncu.limitations: FA3 N224 is not current N192 or MegaMoE. Recovered H100 FC1/FC2 math NCU is separate from H200 serving; synthetic FP32 stores differ from SwiGLU/FP8 and BF16 scatter. No current production fused MegaMoE per-phase NCU found.

recovered_megamoe_math.scope: FP32 materialized math-probe outputs; no NVLink, not production H200

memory_comparison_and_profiler_evidence.decision: PP4/EP1 mb2 is an unproven candidate. User subsequently authorized H200 one-node PoC because ASPIRE is unavailable. No GPU job has been submitted yet; this update only reuses existing profile data. Current NVLink saturation is not established.
